subject: BlueHarbor: SOC 2 architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Cc: Tom Green <tom.green@blueharbor.ai>, security@blueharbor.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueHarbor: SOC 2 architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to move forward with a SOC 2 architecture review. We'd like to run a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk through: SSO and IdP integration, encryption & KMS strategy, audit log retention/forwarding, and how evidence will be collected for SOC 2.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6/22, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 6/23, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 6/24, 15:00–16:00

Attached is a short SOC 2 evidence checklist that lists the artifacts we typically request. Can you confirm which of the above times work for your security/infra leads and whether you prefer a recording?

Attendees from our side: myself (Sales), Soojin Lee (Solutions), Diego Fernandez (Security Eng), Evelyn Hart (Customer Success).

Thanks,

— Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Hi Logan — thanks for the note.

We can do the review — our security lead (Tom) and infra engineer (Priya) should attend. Quick ask: can you make sure the session covers:
- Our current IdP flow (Okta) and how Redwood expects SAML/SCIM to be configured
- KMS integrations + customer-managed keys options
- How audit logs are surfaced and retention windows (we have compliance window constraints)
- Evidence upload process (preferred formats + size limits)

Of the slots above, we prefer Wed 6/23 14:00 PT, but Tom has a calendar block that day from 14:30–15:30. If you're able to start at 13:30 PT that would be ideal. We also need the call recorded.

Logan — quick internal note before we lock this in with BlueHarbor.

- Diego, can you own KMS/encryption + audit log slides? Specifically: customer-managed key options, envelope encryption flow, and S3/GCS retention + forwarding.
- Evelyn, please prepare the evidence intake flow (upload links, expected formats, timeline to hand off artifacts).
- I'll bring the session plan and 10-min checklist walkthrough.

Hi Alice — thanks for the details, that helps. We can cover all of that. Two quick asks from our side: can Priya (infra) share a short network diagram during the call, and can you confirm whether Okta SCIM user provisioning is already enabled?

We can do Tue 6/23 (start at 13:30 PT) — I know you asked for 13:30 specifically so it won't conflict with Tom's block. Proposed agenda:
- 13:30–13:40: Intros & scope
- 13:40–14:10: SSO (Okta) & SCIM provisioning
- 14:10–14:35: KMS + encryption patterns (Diego)
- 14:35–14:50: Audit logs & evidence intake (Evelyn)
- 14:50–15:00: Action items & next steps

Attaching a short network-zone diagram to help Priya map.

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and record the session.

Best,
— Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
